_comment: Starting set of component fingerprints with versions known to carry published vulnerabilities or to be end-of-life. `below` means every version lower than it is affected (semver compare on numeric parts). Extend freely; checks.update will fetch newer data in a later milestone.

components.name: jQuery
components.note: htmlPrefilter XSS when passing untrusted HTML to manipulation methods

components.name: Bootstrap
components.note: XSS in tooltip/popover data-template and affix

components.name: AngularJS
components.note: AngularJS 1.x reached end of life in January 2022; several unfixed sanitizer bypasses

components.name: Lodash
components.note: Command injection in template; prototype pollution

components.name: Moment.js
components.note: ReDoS in string parsing; path traversal in locale loading

components.name: Vue
components.note: Vue 2 reached end of life December 2023

components.name: PHP
components.note: PHP branches before 8.1 no longer receive security fixes

components.name: nginx
components.note: Older than the current stable branch; HTTP/2 rapid reset mitigations arrived in 1.25.3/1.24.x point releases

components.name: Apache
components.note: Several fixed HTTP/2 and request-handling issues

components.name: OpenSSL
components.note: OpenSSL 1.1.1 reached end of life September 2023

components.name: WordPress
components.note: Keep core on the current release; older branches accumulate fixed XSS and privilege issues
